title: First launch and setup
summary: The SkyRPG title screen and the first-time setup: performance presets, shaders, resource packs, keys and the main settings.

What SkyRPG is, in two lines.

Pick a preset. The one that suits your computer (from its memory, processor threads and graphics card) is named under the cards, and on the first start it is already applied, so you can just continue. Hover a card to see exactly what it sets.

The keys that matter: the SkyRPG keys (K menu, map, backpack, wiki lookup, spell wheel), zoom when Zoomify is installed, and movement. Click a key, then press the new one.
clears. A key shown in red is used by something else too.
The settings that matter most: themed chat, message spacing, the HUD, the minimap, the tab list and the SkyRPG title screen. They are the same settings as K > Settings, so they stay in sync.

Minecraft then shows the graphics mode as Custom, because the preset sets more than the Fast, Fancy and Fabulous buttons. Every preset also sets the biome blend (0, 2, 4 and 6), turns off ambient occlusion on Potato, turns off entity shadows on Potato, and lowers the frame rate when the game is in the background (Potato and Balanced also do that when you are away from the keyboard).
